description: This file is a shell script used within the OpenWrt project to assist with kernel version bumping. It contains functions for version control, Git operations, user messaging, and usage instructions, highlighting its role in automating kernel updates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses command-line options and coordinates the kernel bump process.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the process of updating kernel version files and managing Git operations for version bumping.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Checks for the existence of required external commands and tools.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores Git repository state and handles cleanup after operation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script variables and verifies environment before proceeding.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Helper function to standardize message output with levels such as 'err', 'warning', and 'notice'.

methods.name: e_err
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr.
